license_note: Both the repository and the model weights are released under Moonshot AI's Modified MIT License, which reproduces the MIT grant but requires commercial products above 100 million monthly active users or 20 million US dollars in monthly revenue to prominently display 'Kimi K2'. That conditional attribution obligation is not part of the OSI-approved MIT text, so the release is source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct repository code and model weights, including derivative works

access_boundary: This record represents the moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct repository release at commit fd1984e2b7a3350dbf7305fe73a4ede25c14de50 (last modified 2026-04-23), whose checkpoint is stored in block-fp8. Kimi-K2-Base, the 0905 Instruct update, the Kimi K2 Thinking line, the kimi-k2-0711-preview and turbo API variants, the Moonshot AI API, and downstream requantizations remain separate boundaries.
